methodology: MERRA-2 monthly bias-corrected total precipitation (M2TMNXFLX PRECTOTCORR), version 5.12.4, accessed through NASA Harmony (GES DISC subset) as an area-averaged monthly time series, converted from kg m-2 s-1 to mm/month. Whole calendar years only. Trends are computed afterwards by the analysis module (seasonal Mann-Kendall with Sen's slope); this file describes the data only.
limitations: Each value is an average over the region's box, so it hides what happens inside the box.
Giovanni snaps the requested box to the product's grid; the region it actually analysed is recorded in the provenance.
MERRA-2 is a model reconstruction constrained by observations, not a direct measurement. Changes in what it assimilates can create artificial steps in a record.
Months with no value are kept as empty rows, never filled in.
attribution: MERRA-2 monthly bias-corrected total precipitation (M2TMNXFLX PRECTOTCORR). NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), accessed through NASA Harmony (GES DISC subset) on 2026-11-15.
